verses.original: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD for He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū lê·lō·hê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Give thanks to the God of gods . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵ֣י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū la·’ă·ḏō·nê hā·’ă·ḏō·nîm kî lə·‘ō·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Give thanks to the Lord of lords . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְעֹ֘שֵׂ֤ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת גְּדֹל֣וֹת לְבַדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ō·śêh nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ lə·ḇad·dōw kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He alone . . . does great wonders His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְעֹשֵׂ֣ה הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ō·śêh haš·šā·ma·yim biṯ·ḇū·nāh kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: By His insight He made the heavens . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְרֹקַ֣ע הָ֭אָרֶץ עַל־ הַמָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·rō·qa‘ hā·’ā·reṣ ‘al- ham·mā·yim kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He spread out the earth upon the waters . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְ֭עֹשֵׂה אוֹרִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·‘ō·śêh ’ō·w·rîm gə·ḏō·lîm kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He made the great . . . lights His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: אֶת־ הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת בַּיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- haš·še·meš lə·mem·še·leṯ bay·yō·wm kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: the sun to rule the day . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: אֶת־ הַיָּרֵ֣חַ וְ֭כוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁל֣וֹת בַּלָּ֑יְלָה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- hay·yā·rê·aḥ wə·ḵō·w·ḵā·ḇîm lə·mem·šə·lō·wṯ bal·lā·yə·lāh kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: the moon and stars to govern the night . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְמַכֵּ֣ה מִ֭צְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mak·kêh miṣ·ra·yim biḇ·ḵō·w·rê·hem kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He struck down the firstborn . . . of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֣א יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣê yiś·rā·’êl mit·tō·w·ḵām kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: and brought Israel out from among them . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: בְּיָ֣ד חֲ֭זָקָה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh ū·ḇiz·rō·w·a‘ nə·ṭū·yāh kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: with a mighty hand and an outstretched . . . arm His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְגֹזֵ֣ר יַם־ ס֭וּף לִגְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡō·zêr yam- sūp̄ liḡ·zā·rîm kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He divided the Red Sea in two . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְהֶעֱבִ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·ḇîr yiś·rā·’êl bə·ṯō·w·ḵōw kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: and led Israel through the midst . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְנִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְחֵיל֣וֹ בְיַם־ ס֑וּף כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ni·‘êr par·‘ōh wə·ḥê·lōw ḇə·yam- sūp̄ kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red . . . Sea His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְמוֹלִ֣יךְ עַ֭מּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mō·w·lîḵ ‘am·mōw bam·miḏ·bār kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He led His people through the wilderness . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְ֭מַכֵּה מְלָכִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mak·kêh mə·lā·ḵîm gə·ḏō·lîm kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He struck down great . . . kings His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִ֣ים אַדִּירִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·rōḡ mə·lā·ḵîm ’ad·dî·rîm kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: and slaughtered mighty . . . kings His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: לְ֭סִיחוֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֑י כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·sî·ḥō·wn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Sihon king of the Amorites . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ hab·bā·šān kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: and Og king of Bashan . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan ’ar·ṣām lə·na·ḥă·lāh kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: and He gave their land as an inheritance . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: נַ֭חֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: na·ḥă·lāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḇ·dōw kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: a heritage to His servant Israel . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: שֶׁ֭בְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָ֣כַר לָ֑נוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šip̄·lê·nū zā·ḵar lā·nū kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He remembered us in our low estate . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: וַיִּפְרְקֵ֥נוּ מִצָּרֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·rə·qê·nū miṣ·ṣā·rê·nū kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: and freed us from our enemies . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·ṯên le·ḥem lə·ḵāl bā·śār kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: He gives food to every creature . . . His loving devotion endures forever

verses.original: ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏū lə·’êl haš·šā·mā·yim kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Give thanks to the God of heaven . . . His loving devotion endures forever
